responsibility: Provides the shared floating-point machine description layer for the C-SKY backend, independent of the exact FPU generation. It defines common floating-point unspec codes, mode and code iterators, generic expanders for moves, arithmetic, fused multiply-add, comparisons, cstore/cbranch expansion, and scalar conversions across HF/SF/DF modes, then delegates concrete encodings to the FPUv2 and FPUv3 subfiles, making it the top-level organization point for C-SKY floating-point instruction selection.
